summary: Firefox is moving Web Speech recognition to local, on-device processing using downloadable models, including Parakeet-based streaming recognition, instead of the previous online implementation. Users get a permission prompt and download progress before a model is installed, with AI Controls and a permission policy governing access; the API now exposes streaming confidence, timing events, multilingual model selection, unspoken punctuation, and clearer install or recognition errors. Extensive race, abort, lifecycle, and end-to-end tests improve reliability and ensure the hardware-inference process and downloaded models are cleaned up correctly.
